execution_targets_docker_fields_check.name: execution_targets_docker_fields_check
execution_targets_docker_fields_check.value: "execution_targets"."kind" <> 'DOCKER_CONTAINER' or ("execution_targets"."container_name" is not null and "execution_targets"."expected_container_id" is not null and "execution_targets"."start_policy" is not null)

prompt_bindings_selector_value_check.name: prompt_bindings_selector_value_check
prompt_bindings_selector_value_check.value: ("prompt_bindings"."selector_type" = 'LABEL' and "prompt_bindings"."label" is not null and "prompt_bindings"."version_id" is null) or ("prompt_bindings"."selector_type" = 'VERSION' and "prompt_bindings"."version_id" is not null and "prompt_bindings"."label" is null)
